newsitem.title: USA: Group V in deal with Universal Network.
newsitem.headline: Group V in deal with Universal Network.

text.p: Group V Corp said Universal Network Services Inc, a Southern California-based long distance and prepaid calling card provider, has purchased just under five percent of Group V's shares.

Universal Network Services has joined the investment group headed by Joseph Monterosso, Group V president, through which it bought about 45,000 shares of series B preferred stock for about $1.75 million.
The Company also said that UNS will provide the long distance and prepaid calling card services for the Hit- LoTTo(TM) group-play program to be launched later this year.
